tools.name: search_notices
tools.description: Search published death and funeral notices by name, service location or funeral home. Newest first. Returns service times and places (local time with the time zone) and a link to each notice.

tools.name: get_notice
tools.description: Full details of one published funeral notice: every service with its location, livestream link and information, the funeral home, and the memorial page if there is one.

tools.name: search_memorials
tools.description: Search published online memorials for people and pets by name. Newest first. Returns dates, the funeral home if there is one, and a link to each memorial.

tools.name: get_memorial
tools.description: Details of one published memorial: dates, life story (obituary, shortened if long), service details, how many tributes it has, the funeral home and the link. Details the family keeps for QR code visitors are left out.

tools.name: search_funeral_directors
tools.description: Find funeral homes that are Forever In Our Hearts partners, by name, city, state or postcode, or by country. Returns name, logo, address, contact details and the funeral home's notices and memorials site.
